newsitem.title: ESTONIA: PORT BOARD TO REVIEW CONTAINER TERMINAL - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: PORT BOARD TO REVIEW CONTAINER TERMINAL - REPORT.

text.p: The Port of Tallinn's supervisory board is expected to discuss the provision of operating services for Muuga Port's proposed container terminal on Tuesday, Aripaev newspaper said on Monday.

Sander Liive, financial director of the Port of Tallinn, said that the board will discuss a tender submitted by the ferry terminal for the provision of cranes and technical facilities to operate in the new terminal, the business daily said.
The Muuga container terminal is expected to cost 300 million kroons, but the port needs to build two new wharves and the required infrastructure, the newspaper added.
